method: Structural one-hots + LP-axis Sterimol + scalar %Vbur + %Vbur asymmetry + molecule-global xTB scalars (HOMO, LUMO, gap, dipole) + RDKit trivial scalars. No carbene-localised electronics.
xtb_scalar_source: xtb_homo_eV/xtb_lumo_eV/xtb_gap_eV re-parsed from the post-convergence block of data/xtb/outputs/C*.txt on 2026-09-18 (features/interpretable/repair_xtb_scalars.py); earlier values were read at the unoptimised input geometry.
duplicate_carbene_policy: Free-carbene descriptors are canonicalised across salt forms: the 161 entries are 113 distinct free carbenes, and each group carries the values of its lowest-xTB-energy member (features/interpretable/canonicalize_duplicates.py, 19.09.2026).
